sentences.en: The people who work at a carnival are called "carnies."
sentences.zh: 在嘉年华工作的人被称为'嘉年华人(carnie)'。

sentences.en: "Yes, I am Brazilian. No, I don't like carnival."
sentences.zh: "是的，我是巴西人。不，我不喜欢狂欢节。"

sentences.en: The carnival of Venice is one of the world's oldest and best-known.
sentences.zh: 威尼斯的嘉年华是世界上最古老和最著名的之一。

senses.zh: 狂欢节,嘉年华,节日，联欢
